entries.sourceEnglish: Note where frost sits longest, where the ground smells damp in dry months, and where khakibos or blackjack grow thick. These plants can grow in disturbed places, but their presence alone does not show whether soil is compacted. Check the soil before deciding what the patch means for your design.

entries.sourceEnglish: Frost is ice that forms on a cold surface. Mist alone does not show that ice has formed, and frost damage can happen without visible ice. Look for ice and plant damage, compare low ground with slopes, and check minimum temperatures where you can. Mark places where cold or damage lasts longest. Keep sensitive plants away from the cold pockets you observe.
